requirements.title: Synthetic Sensor Measurements from Truth State
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall generate synthetic IMU, barometer, and GPS measurements from the sim_dynamics truth state.
requirements.rationale: PM-required SITL sensor models feed the FSW POSIX driver layer in place of real hardware for closed-loop Trick simulation.

requirements.title: Synthetic IMU Sample Rate
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall produce synthetic IMU measurements at 200 Hz.
requirements.rationale: PM-required match to SW-REQ-SYS-005 so FSW POSIX drivers consume sim IMU at the same rate as real IMU.

requirements.title: Synthetic IMU Accelerometer Range Saturation
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall saturate synthetic accelerometer outputs at plus or minus 16 G.
requirements.rationale: PM-required match to SW-REQ-SYS-006 so sim IMU exhibits the same saturation behavior as the real accelerometer.

requirements.title: Synthetic IMU Gyroscope Range Saturation
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall saturate synthetic gyroscope outputs at plus or minus 2000 degrees per second.
requirements.rationale: PM-required match to SW-REQ-SYS-007 so sim IMU exhibits the same saturation behavior as the real gyroscope.

requirements.title: Synthetic IMU Quantization
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall quantize synthetic IMU measurements to 16-bit signed integers across the configured range.
requirements.rationale: PM-required ADC quantization match to real IMU so FSW driver layer observes identical resolution behavior.

requirements.title: Configurable IMU Noise and Bias
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall apply configurable white noise and bias to synthetic IMU measurements.
requirements.rationale: PM-required realism so nav-evaluation runs reflect realistic IMU error characteristics; parameters loaded from sim_scenario.

requirements.title: Synthetic Barometer Sample Rate
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall produce synthetic barometer measurements at 20 Hz.
requirements.rationale: PM-required match to SW-REQ-SYS-008 so FSW POSIX drivers consume sim baro at the same cadence as real baro.

requirements.title: Standard Atmosphere Pressure and Temperature
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall derive synthetic pressure and temperature from truth altitude using a standard atmosphere model.
requirements.rationale: PM-required physically consistent baro outputs anchored to truth altitude for closed-loop nav evaluation.

requirements.title: Configurable Barometer Noise
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall apply configurable noise to synthetic barometer measurements.
requirements.rationale: PM-required realism so nav baro fusion is exercised under realistic noise; parameters loaded from sim_scenario.

requirements.title: Synthetic GPS Sample Rate
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall produce synthetic GPS position fixes at 5 Hz.
requirements.rationale: PM-required match to SW-REQ-SYS-009 so FSW POSIX drivers consume sim GPS at the same cadence as real GPS.

requirements.title: Configurable GPS Quality and Latency
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall apply configurable HDOP, VDOP, fix latency, and satellite count to synthetic GPS fixes.
requirements.rationale: PM-required realism so nav GPS fusion is exercised under realistic quality variation; parameters loaded from sim_scenario.

requirements.title: Configurable GPS Dropout Windows
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall suppress synthetic GPS fixes during configured dropout windows.
requirements.rationale: PM-required ability to inject GPS outages so nav degraded-input continuation is exercised in simulation.

requirements.title: Sensor Output Frames and Units Match Real Hardware
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall emit measurements in the same frames and SI units as the real sensors.
requirements.rationale: PM-required so FSW POSIX driver layer consumes sim measurements identically per SW-REQ-SYS-038 through 042 and 057.

requirements.title: Sensor Model Parameters from Sim Scenario
requirements.description: The sim_sensors module shall load all noise, bias, and dropout parameters from the sim_scenario configuration.
requirements.rationale: PM-required configurability so different sim runs exercise different sensor error profiles without code changes.
